the fallback chain classifies the error: an unknown or
non-retriable error is returned at once; on an earlier
candidate a rate-limit error may retry the same
candidate (up to 3 calls) and other retriable errors go
to the next candidate at once (cooldowns skip bad ones);
on the last candidate the chain can still try (for a
single-model agent, that model) a separate retry plan
or interrupted-stream failures it makes up to 6 calls in
total with waits of about 2, 5, 10, 20 and 40 s (the
provider's Retry-After replaces a step), subject to the
guards; once visible text has streamed the chain stops;
a user cancel means no fallback
